blurb: Fells Point Surf Co operates retail stores in Baltimore, Bethany Beach, and Dewey Beach. They sell surf and beach-related products including towels, swimwear, and skateboards. The Baltimore store is open year-round, while the beach stores are seasonal.
extraNote: Returnable items that are unworn/unused may be returned within 30 days of purchase with original receipt/packing slip. · Sunglasses, women’s swim suits, skateboards, surfboards and bodyboards may not be returned or exchanged. · Refunds issued according to original method of payment; cash refunds for in-store purchases if register funds sufficient, else refund check within 2 weeks. · Local delivery available within 10 miles of Baltimore store and 5 miles of Bethany Beach and Dewey Beach stores; delivery fees apply for orders under $75. · Baltimore store open year-round; beach stores open seasonally
